about: E32 content of the kit map (E27 design section 6, R-E32-01): authoring/kitmap/build.py copies supplies, stock, candidate_supplies and candidate_skills into config/kit-map.json. The kit-map schema gives a catalog entry no citation field, so each supply's sources are kept here under provenance; build.py refuses a supply without one. RS IDs are in docs/product/RESPONDER-FLOWS.md (sources table); every source is NASA's except RS30 (NHS), used only for the rinse duration, which no NASA source states.

supplies.name: Clean water for an eye rinse

eye_rinse_water.quote: Immediate eye irrigation therapy is the most important initial management of chemical eye burns

eye_rinse_water.locator: ISS Medical Checklist JSC-48522-E4 (2001, historical), p. 558, Eye problems: chemical burn
eye_rinse_water.quote: Prior to SSE configuration, attempt eye irrigation with Drink Bag, Drink Straw.

eye_rinse_water.locator: Eye injuries (NHS; not NASA), duration only
eye_rinse_water.quote: run lots of water over your eyeball for at least 20 minutes

eye_shield.quote: Place a rigid shield over the eye and tape it to the skin covering the rigid periorbital bone so that there is no pressure on the globe
Shielding of the eye will also be needed to protect from further damage.

eye_shield.locator: ISS Medical Checklist JSC-48522-E4 (2001, historical), p. 590, Eye problems: penetrating object
eye_shield.quote: Tape metal Eye Shield over Eye Pad.

eye_wash_set.locator: ISS Medical Checklist JSC-48522-E4 (2001, historical), p. 558, Eye problems: chemical burn; SSE is the Space Station Eyewash (Figure 1 of the procedure)
eye_wash_set.quote: For definitive eye flush, deploy SSE near SVO-ZV interface.

towels.locator: ISS Medical Checklist JSC-48522-E4 (2001, historical), p. 558, Eye problems: chemical burn
towels.quote: Use Towels to absorb excess water.

stock_note: No stock row. RS08 is the only source with packed quantities (p. 988: Eye Shield, Metallic, 1; p. 1002: Space Station Eyewash (SSE), 1), and it is a superseded 2001 ISS inventory, not a packing list for any environment the product serves. E32 8.2: no packed quantity has a source today, and S-L4 rejects a sourced row until R-E32-03 adds source_ids. No source gives a rinse water volume. A step that needs a supply without stock reads not aboard and fails closed (E28 14c) until the flight surgeon sets a team default row.
